sources.description: Washington State (1-6, 0-3 in Pac-12) hosts Boise State (5-1, 2-0 in Pac-12) in the school’s first-ever Pac-12 conference matchup. WSU, led quarterback Owen Eshelman, looked to build off of a strong offensive performance against Oregon State last week.
